_comment: The features a Switch-to-iOS port MUST have. The self-test feature_manifest.py checks the kit
against this file: the source markers must be present, and the named self-tests must exist.
This is the answer to 'will the next port have the features we built'. A new port that passes
feature_manifest.py has every feature listed here. A feature that is added to this file
becomes a requirement for every future port.
The 'kind' is how it is checked: 'source' = a marker text in a kit file; 'test' = a self-test
that must exist; 'tool' = a tool in kit/tools/ with a marker.
